issues.description: SQL query in solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql is missing the join condition that links Schwimmbad to Gemeinde. Problem statement (lines 46-49) requests a list of Gemeinde names that have a 'Freibad' and the names of the respective Freibäder. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql) selects Gemeinde.name and Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad' but does not include Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel, which produces a Cartesian product filtered only by Schwimmbad.art. The template (template_repository/aufgabe07.sql) is empty. This inconsistency causes incorrect results and can confuse students about whether a join to link the two tables is required.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the join condition linking Schwimmbad to Gemeinde in the reference solution so only Gemeinden that actually have a Freibad are returned. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; Update solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql accordingly.
